_how_to: Confirmed by Lina, 3 Oct 2026 (sign-off file applied; DECISIONS 2026-10-03, 11:40). Drafted by Claude knowing the rules' vocabulary, so the set leans towards wording the rules miss; that bias is disclosed with any result. A targeted development comparison, not an independent generalisation result. Excluded by design: the customer's question, 'A draft Statement of Work will follow.' (sales step), all of PC-05 (pointer and boilerplate), PC-03 (reference-only). 15 statements, 12 commitments. Frozen in data/practice_cases.sha256; never edited after extraction or checker results.
